title: Code for: ERA5 and GFS Cloud Cover vs. CloudSEN12+ - Can NWP Replace Expert Labels?
description:
Analysis and experiment code accompanying the manuscript ERA5 and GFS Cloud Cover vs. CloudSEN12+: Can NWP Replace Expert Labels? by Anna Anzalone and Antonio Pagliaro, submitted to Applied Sciences (MDPI), 2026.

The study asks whether freely available cloud-cover fields from numerical weather prediction (NWP) products can replace expensive expert pixel-level annotations when training cloud detectors for Sentinel-2. It has two parts: the collocation of ERA5 and GFS total cloud cover with 48,380 expert-annotated CloudSEN12+ patches spanning 2017-2022, and a set of controlled U-Net experiments in which architecture, spectral input, training budget, data split and test set are held fixed so that only the source of the training labels varies.

The repository contains the download scripts for CloudSEN12+, ERA5 and GFS, the collocation and bootstrap statistics, the collocation-scheme sensitivity test, and the U-Net training, evaluation and plotting scripts, together with a README mapping each script to the table or figure of the paper it produces.
